nodes.label: seaborn.objects
nodes.desc: Public namespace re-exporting Plot, Mark subclasses, Stat subclasses, Move subclasses, and Scale subclasses.

nodes.label: Plot
nodes.desc: Immutable spec object; every method clones, mutates the clone, and returns it.

nodes.label: Plot.add()
nodes.desc: Appends a layer dict {mark, stat, move, vars, source, legend, label, orient}; at most one Stat first, then Moves.

nodes.label: Plot.facet()
nodes.desc: Stores col/row variables, optional order, and wrap in the facet spec.

nodes.label: Plot.pair()
nodes.desc: Renames x/y lists to x0..xN/y0..yN keys; cross=True makes a grid, cross=False zips pairs.

nodes.label: Plotter
nodes.desc: Engine created by Plot._plot(); holds scales, layers, figure, and legend contents.

nodes.label: Plotter._setup_figure()
nodes.desc: Builds the matplotlib figure via Subplots.init_figure and records subplot views.

nodes.label: Plotter._setup_scales()
nodes.desc: Runs twice: first for coordinate variables, then again for columns the stat transforms added.

nodes.label: Plotter._compute_stats()
nodes.desc: For each layer with a Stat: infers orient, builds GroupBy over grouping vars, and calls stat(df, groupby, orient, scales).

nodes.label: Plotter._plot_layer()
nodes.desc: Computes width from scale spacing, applies Move chain, unscales coords, then calls mark._plot(split_generator).

nodes.label: Plotter._unscale_coords()
nodes.desc: Converts scaled coordinates back to data units using axis.get_transform().inverted().transform.

nodes.label: Plotter._finalize_figure()
nodes.desc: Applies limits, labels, titles, and legend placement to the finished figure.

nodes.label: Subplots
nodes.desc: Parses facet/pair specs into grid dimensions, wrap handling, and axis-sharing rules.

nodes.label: _handle_wrapping()
nodes.desc: wrap=N trims the wrap dimension and computes the flow dimension as ceil(n_subplots / wrap); extra Axes are removed.

nodes.label: init_figure()
nodes.desc: Creates the Figure via plt.figure or mpl.figure.Figure and target.subplots(**subplot_spec, squeeze=False).

nodes.label: Stat
nodes.desc: Dataclass base; group_by_orient ClassVar and __call__(data, groupby, orient, scales) -> DataFrame.

nodes.label: Agg
nodes.desc: Aggregates the value axis with func='mean' (or any Series method/callable).

nodes.label: Est
nodes.desc: Estimate plus errorbar='ci' at 95%; n_boot=1000; switches to WeightedAggregator when a weight variable exists.

nodes.label: Hist
nodes.desc: Histogram binning stat for the objects interface.

nodes.label: KDE
nodes.desc: Kernel density estimate stat; supports multivariate grids for density plots.

nodes.label: PolyFit
nodes.desc: numpy.polynomial fit stat behind Plot.add(PolyFit()) regression lines.

nodes.label: EstimateAggregator
nodes.desc: Bootstrap machinery shared with the classic function API's errorbar computation.

nodes.label: GroupBy
nodes.desc: Ordered grouping wrapper over pandas groupby used by every Stat and Move.

nodes.label: Dodge (Move)
nodes.desc: Post-stat position adjustment; Moves run after the Stat inside _plot_layer.

nodes.label: Mark
nodes.desc: Base class with Mappable dataclass fields; _resolve() picks specified, mapped, dependent, or default values.

nodes.label: Dots
nodes.desc: Unfilled scatter mark (Dot is the filled variant); artists added per split.

nodes.label: Bars
nodes.desc: Thinner bar edges variant of Bar; both derive from BarBase.

nodes.label: Lines
nodes.desc: Aggregated line segments variant of Paths; Line and Range/Dash live in the same module.

nodes.label: Band
nodes.desc: ymin/ymax band mark sharing AreaBase with Area; fills between two coordinate columns.

nodes.label: Scale
nodes.desc: Base scale dataclass; _setup() attaches locators/formatters and a data-to-visual mapper.

nodes.label: Nominal
nodes.desc: Categorical scale building an order-based unit mapping; default for string data.

nodes.label: Continuous
nodes.desc: Numeric scale with trans= functional transforms and tick()/label() builders.

nodes.label: PseudoAxis
nodes.desc: Minimal Axis stand-in so non-coordinate variables like color can reuse matplotlib transform machinery.

nodes.label: handle_data_source()
nodes.desc: Accepts DataFrames, mappings, or any object exposing to_pandas().
